text: The two failures interact through the representation choice: a more expressive representation describes more of reality but is harder to reason about, so every governance design must choose where on this frontier to sit.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Governance as a Product (GaaP): A Reputation-Weighted Institutional Architecture for Autonomous AI Agent Governance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6886078

isBasedOn.name: Governance as a Product (GaaP): A Reputation-Weighted Institutional Architecture for Autonomous AI Agent Governance

abstract: The two failures interact. The choice of representation determines the scope of reliable reasoning. A more expressive representation can describe more of reality but is harder to reason about; a less expressive representation enables reliable reasoning over a narrower domain. Any governance design must therefore choose where on this frontier to sit
